description:
Activate Vhal by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}{C} that cannot be spent to cast spells from your hand.
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Sewer-veillance Cam.
When the Sewer-veillance Cam token enters, it triggers, untapping Vhal.
Repeat.

uses.name: Vhal, Candlekeep Researcher
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and with toughness 5 or greater
